text.en: Reading the spreading of a random walk as a drift in some direction. Average the displacement over many walkers and you get exactly zero — there is no preferred direction anywhere in the process. What grows with time is the width of the distribution, and that is what the root-mean-square displacement measures: half the walkers are on each side, just further out than before.
text.et: Juhusliku ekslemise laialivalgumise mõistmine triivina mingis suunas. Keskmista nihe üle paljude ekslejate ja saad täpselt nulli — protsessis ei ole kusagil eelissuunda. Ajas kasvab jaotuse laius ja just seda mõõdabki ruutkeskmine nihe: pooled ekslejad on kummalgi pool, lihtsalt kaugemal kui varem.
